user_query: As an avid news reader, I want to receive a curated daily newsletter with the top news stories from Alarabiya, France24 Arabic, and CNN Arabic. Please include the headlines, content, images, and source names in the newsletter.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top news stories from Alarabiya.
Fetch the top news stories from France24 Arabic.
Fetch the top news stories from CNN Arabic.
Compile the fetched news stories from all sources into a single curated newsletter.
Format the newsletter to include headlines, content, images, and source names.
Send the formatted newsletter to the user via email.
